name: tsid
description: Generate a new Time-Sorted Unique Identifier — a 32-character hex string. Optional seed string makes IDs from the same seed reproducible-ordered. Calls within the same microsecond stay distinct.

examples.code: SELECT tsid() AS id FROM range(100);

name: tsid_to_timestamp
description: Extract the embedded timestamp from a TSID. Returns TIMESTAMP — the time the ID was generated.

examples.description: Recover when a row was inserted from its id alone
examples.code: SELECT id, tsid_to_timestamp(id) AS created_at FROM events;
